description: This PHP class 'EmpWorkExperienceDecorator' is a decorator for the 'EmpWorkExperience' entity, providing methods to access formatted dates, compute work duration, and set employee references via employee number, within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmpWorkExperienceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpWorkExperience entity, providing additional presentation logic and helper methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpWorkExperience entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the associated Employee entity in the work experience by employee number.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted 'from date' of the work experience.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted 'to date' of the work experience.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration of employment in years as a rounded decimal.
